text:
San Jose's Kiara Romero finishes 29th at CPKC Women's Open on Aug. 23
By
T. N. ArroyoA lone golfer from San Jose, California competed at the CPKC Women's Open, an LPGA Tour event that concluded Sunday, Aug. 23.
Kiara Romero finished 29th with a total score of 275, 5 under par.
Romero, who played at Oregon, opened with a 64 in the first round, followed by rounds of 67, 69 and 75 to close out the tournament.
Miyu Yamashita won the event at 257, 23 under par. Yuri Yoshida took second at 266, 14 under par, while Sei Young Kim finished third with 267, 13 under par.
